answer: Cross-epoch trajectory scoring. Each agent’s action vector is scored per epoch; the score is the sine of the angle between consecutive epoch vectors—a tundra-flat profile (near-zero directional change) is flagged. Agents must show bounded but nonzero drift toward a declared target (e.g., a zenith reached by gradual ascent, not a cliff-edge canyon jump). Clones executing identical scripts produce collinear trajectories and collapse to zero.
